children: Advanced Flower Capital reported that it had repurchased 1,190,221 shares under its $5.0 million repurchase program as of November 24, 2026.
The program permits open-market repurchases of up to $5.0 million of common stock, but the company is not obligated to buy shares.
After repurchases through November 24, 2026, 22,338,623 common shares were issued and outstanding.
Unless amended or extended, the program is expected to end when $5.0 million of shares have been repurchased or on May 4, 2027, whichever comes first.
